title: SAP MDG Consultant
description:
SAP MDG lead/ Technical Consultant As an SAP MDG Technical Consultant, will develop, customize, and support SAP MDG applications. Responsibilities include configuring data models, creating BRF+ (Business Rules Frameworks Plus) rules, developing UI enhancements, integrating MDG with other systems, and ensuring data quality through technical solutions. Collaborate with functional teams to implement scalable, efficient master data governance frameworks aligned with business needs. Responsible for analyzing requirements, design, develop and implement Enterprise Master Data solutions using SAP MDG. Understanding of Master Data Domains like custom-er/vendor/financials/materials Be able to advise on the merits and demerits of different solution approaches in sight and recommend the best solution from technical feasibility point of view. Ability to work independently on Project and Lead project technically Ability to draw & implement Enterprise level architecture Assist in day-to-day operations of customer discussion w.r.t design and development. Recommend best practice solutions, based on research of emerging products, services, protocols and standards. Works extensively with customers along with appropriate internal and external resources on the strategy/deployment/optimization of Product services and solutions Takes lead role in execution of projects 
 SAP MDG Lead/ Functional Consultant 
SAP MDG Functional Consultant, will design, configure, and support SAP Master Data Governance solutions. Responsibilities include analyzing business requirements, implementing data models and workflows, ensuring data quality and compliance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize master data processes. You will play a key role in driving data governance strategy and system improvements. Good knowledge on Objects - customer, supplier, material, and finance (cost center, chart of accounts, profit center) Minimum 2 End to End implementation project and 2 Support project Knowledge of and Experience in Agile and Waterfall Methodology Knowledge of and Experience ITIL processes Strong knowledge of SAP MDG and master data management concepts. Experience with SAP ERP, SAP ECC, and SAP NetWeaver. Understanding of data governance principles and frameworks. Analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to work with diverse stakeholders in multi-vendor environment Implement and configure SAP MDG solutions for master data management. Design and develop data governance policies, procedures, and standards. Collaborate with stakeholders to identify master data requirements. Develop and maintain data validation rules, workflows, and approval processes. Ensure data quality, consistency, and integrity across the organization. Analyze and resolve data-related issues and errors. Develop training materials and conduct workshops for end-users. Collaborate with IT teams to integrate SAP MDG with other SAP systems. Stay up-to-date with SAP MDG releases, updates, and best practices. SAP MDG certification is plus Communication with Customer for requirement gathering, Detailed design and sign off. Good problem-solving skills Team player Willing to learn and grow technical

title: Sap Ewm Consultant
description:
Responsibilities: We are looking for a motivated SAP S4HANA EWM consultant with a passion for the manufacturing industry. As an SAP S4HANA EWM consultant, you will be responsible for assisting in various projects related to SAP EWM implementation tasks. You will work closely with a team of experienced professionals to implement & support SAP EWM solutions. Key Responsibilities: Implementation: Configuring, implementing, and maintaining the SAP S4HANA EWM module Business process analysis: Identifying gaps in business processes against SAP best practices Facilitate implementation and support of SAP S/4 Hana and S/4 Hana Warehouse Management Innovation including seamless integration between warehouse management & production, visibility & control of stocks, Fiori Apps and Warehouse KPIs Operations. Testing: Creating test data, running tests, and creating and executing test scripts Continuous improvement: Monitoring system performance, identifying opportunities for improvement, and recommending enhancements Business process modeling: Defining and modeling business processes Feasibility verification: Verifying the feasibility of the developed model An SAP EWM specialist needs to have in-depth knowledge of warehouse logistics, SAP EWM functionalities, and integration with other SAP modules. Bring in strong business process knowledge on EWM processes and integration with cross modules like Production Planning, Material Management, Quality Management and SCM Build global EWM template and propose process improvement plans Bring in expert knowledge of warehouse management including basic warehouse management and advanced warehouse management processes Ensure effective communication to all stake holders (Business, PMO office, Client Partner etc.) from scope, Risks and Business Impacts perspective Hold regular project portfolio Integration meetings, ensure all developments follow standards Govern risks imposed by Cross Application projects that affect SAP project portfolio
